purpose: Corpus-wide grouping and holdout policy for the unified source recovery effort. Groups reference content hashes; classification evidence is reused from the existing manifest, never duplicated here.
manifest_summary: 900 files, 894 unique contents, 402 dynamic, 498 static, 0 unknown/malformed (recorded evidence; not a re-scan).
deduplication: Same sha256 counts as one sample regardless of path; pasteboard appears in both roots under one identity.

membership.rule: Resolve membership before method selection: a holdout hash is excluded from every development path alias and pool. Explicit named development cohorts precede the residual pool. Contradictory named families require reconciliation, not duplicate evidence.

profile_layering.rule: Historical profiles never use v7 rules without pinned per-profile evidence; multiple applications on one profile do not count as cross-profile validation. Where a real corpus lacks a profile, existing historical fixtures cover it and the gap is recorded.

static_inputs.policy: Persisted skip per abc-index evidence; never counted as source-recovery success; unknown/malformed/decode-failure are never classified static.
